portInfo.description: Beirut rewards a tightly focused cultural day rather than an unsupported promise to cover Lebanon from a ship. Sursock offers art in Ashrafieh, AUB’s museum traces the region’s archaeology, and the National Museum provides another substantial collection. The Barakat Building’s civil-war history needs careful interpretation, not a glib photo-stop description. Those researched places do not establish that a cruise can currently discharge passengers safely. A viable day begins with a real call, approved port transport, a route-specific security decision and confirmed venue access. Keep northern/eastern city museum choices separate from districts under different warnings; this guide does not certify any route as safe based on a city label.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Sursock Museum, Greek Orthodox Archbishopric Street, Ashrafieh: 90 minutes for art; its visit page confirms wheelchair-accessible galleries/facilities and Wednesday–Sunday opening.

National Museum of Beirut, Council of Europe location 33.879143, 35.515040 / VGH8+92: allow two hours; published institutional coordinates locate the museum, not a port or security-approved route. Confirm current admission.
AUB Archaeological Museum, Bliss Street campus: the museum recommends one hour and lists weekday seasonal hours; campus entry and holidays must be checked separately.

Beit Beirut / Barakat Building, Damascus Street at Independence Street, Sodeco: 45 minutes of historically informed exterior context only if the route is permitted and safe. The old official project site does not establish interior opening; do not promise a museum tour.

Saint Nicolas stairs / Gemmayzeh, starting at the top near Sursock and ending on Gouraud Street: a 45-minute heritage streetscape walk. The museum locates itself 40 metres left of the stair top; a stepped route is unsuitable for some mobility needs. Reconfirm local conditions; this is not an approved port-to-city walk.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Evidence of a lounge is not evidence of a sailing; evidence of a museum address is not evidence of a safe route. Resolve both before turning contingency research into a visitor recommendation.
